name: JSONL Event Exporter
description: Appends Resin events to daily JSON Lines files in the plugin data directory. Written in Python with no dependencies to show the raw protocol.
author: Resin examples

config_fields.name: events
config_fields.label: Events
config_fields.description: Event types to write: *, request.finished, lease.* or a single lease event type.

config_fields.name: directory
config_fields.label: Directory
config_fields.description: Output directory. Defaults to the plugin data directory.

config_fields.name: retention_days
config_fields.label: Retention (days)
config_fields.description: Delete files older than this many days. 0 keeps everything.
